notes.title: Announce my new game!
notes.content: [p]Greetings everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I'm excited to announce my next game — [b][i]Time to Pay the Bills[/i][/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Time to Pay the Bills is a [b]financial roguelike[/b] where your paycheck depends on your pinball shots. Manage your wallet and use [b]game-changing banking cards[/b] to trigger [b]combos[/b] and survive another month's [b]rising bills[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478570/1c1c362cf55b154dfc697deeefc44eef8d9c72bd.png"][/img][/p][p]If you enjoy turn-based tactical roguelike with a side of financial madness — [b][i]consider adding Time to Pay the Bills to your wishlist![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3931600/Time_to_Pay_the_Bills/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Patch: Controller support is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478570/5de978790b72d1c42512f6e7c8ef9f5b33957f68.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Since the game launch I published some lite updates without any announcements. But this patch is different, so I want to make it special.[b] I'm happy to announce the controller support is available now![/b] Detailed list of changes read below.

[h3]Patch note:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Implemented controller support.
[*]Fixed mirror rotation speed.
[*]Fixed player jittering.
[*]Some puzzles have been remade.
[*]Springboard in combination with teleports have been remade.
[*]Disabled manual trajectory for throwing objects.
[*]Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Adventure Light is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478570/5de978790b72d1c42512f6e7c8ef9f5b33957f68.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

It has been a long journey since I started working on the game and now I'm happy to announce that the Adventure Light is officially being released!

A mysterious and atmospheric world of puzzles based on teleport feature awaits you!

notes.title: Adventure Light is releasing February 1st 2023!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZU_wqtcuft4;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone! 

I'm happy to announce that Adventure Light is going to be released on [b]February 1st, 2023[/b] on Steam.

Make sure to wishlist and follow the game to get notified as soon as it's available!
